IPT.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/15] The cognitive-behavioural programme 'Taking Action', used in the present pilot study, is a Dutch translation, by the author of this study, of the manual developed in 1996 by Kevin Stark, University of Texas, and Philip Kendall, Temple University [50].

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/15] The manual is intended for children between the ages of 9 and 13, suffering from a unipolar depressive disorder, dysthymia, or depressed mood.

Source.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/2] The children were taught to self-monitor positive events and pleasant emotions by using an emotions diary.
